body: Autonomy red-team decision: the existing ordinary-source Learnings navigation contract is blocked by cards.toSummaryView exposing source only when generation exists (cards.ts120), despite the existing UI reading card.source.items. This is a repair to the approved provenance/ordinary-card compatibility behavior, not a new feature or schema. Assign the minimal serializer correction and existing cards.test.ts regression to DM-730's implementation owner alongside its UI consumer; expose an authoritative bound immutable source without classifying an ordinary card as generated. Preserve generic approval and discriminate generated cards by kind/generation, not mere source presence. DM-799 remains strictly proof-only. Main will defer DM-799 dispatch until this correction is accepted/integrated, even though server readiness permits earlier claim; no new Save or user choice is required. Fresh per-attempt proof roots, accepted source SHAs, CDP AND renderer ports must be assigned; historical dm731/dm798 scripts are references, never reused unchanged.
